basics.name: Andrew R. Wimmer
basics.label: Orthopedic Medical Device Sales Leader
basics.summary: Orthopedic medical device sales leader: 13 years with Arthrex, built on a clinical foundation in surgical technology. Run a rural hospital territory across Sports Medicine, Foot & Ankle Trauma, Arthroplasty, Biologics and Capital Equipment, grown at a 24.9% CAGR since 2015. Built Arthroplasty from zero into a major product line and grew Foot & Ankle Trauma 10x. Named Arthrex Territory of the Year, West Region (2015), and Arthrex-Omaha Foot & Ankle, Trauma Territory of the Year (FY26).
